text:
**No qualifying deforestation was detected after 2020** on ASSET-B through 2025.

The data show 0.4 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2021, but it occurred in patches below the 0.5-hectare minimum event size. The JRC reference also mapped no forest on the asset in 2020, so the loss is not corroborated as post-2020 deforestation under the stated rule.
